title: About The Private Ledger
description: Why The Private Ledger researches private companies, who it serves, and how the research is done.
body:
ABOUT THE PRIVATE LEDGER

The place for in-depth research on the private market.

When The Private Ledger began on April 28, 2026, the aim was to cover a niche that few publications cover well: the private market.

Private companies are harder to research. Information is often limited, important details are hidden, and the businesses can be clouded in mystery. Proper research is painstaking and lengthy. That is exactly why this work matters.

Research beyond the surface.

For the ByteDance breakdown, The Private Ledger used more than 50 sources, spoke off the record with a Chinese lawyer to better understand the work culture, and spent days working through obscure Chinese websites. That level of effort is the standard: raw analytical depth over marketing fluff.

WHAT THE RESEARCH FOLLOWS

Financials

How the business makes money.

Valuations

What the market is pricing in.

Competitive advantages

Where a company's strengths lie.

IPO analysis

The transition from private to public.

WHY LOOK AT THE PRIVATE MARKET?

Every company starts private.

When a company is big enough and the time is right, it may decide to go public. The Private Ledger is built for investors who want to understand that story earlier.

01

Public-market investors

Understand private competitors before judging a public company. To assess PayPal, for example, it helps to understand Stripe.

02

Accredited investors

Research businesses while they are still private, before the public-market decision arrives.

03

IPO watchers

Follow the macro trends, timing, and red flags around companies preparing to go public.

04

Retail investors

Look ahead to the companies quietly dominating their niches today and potentially the public markets tomorrow.

05

Private fund managers

Get a clearer picture of private companies and the markets in which they operate.

Follow the story, years before everyone else.

My goal is to track companies today that can become public-market giants tomorrow. As more companies remain private for longer, independent coverage of the private market matters more than ever.

I have already written on SpaceX, Anthropic, Anduril, and more. The deep dives will continue weekly.

Explore the research →

The Private Ledger is built for investors, VCs, and market observers who demand raw analytical depth over marketing fluff in an industry few are covering. Research is for educational and informational purposes and is not investment advice.
